value.rationale: The standard Pappus graph is the canonical 18-vertex cubic symmetric Levi graph of a 9_3 configuration; its complete ordinary geodesic visibility complex is a natural exact object. The 2023 established lower mutual-visibility invariant asks how far greedy maximal placements can fall below the optimum; exact 6 versus 8 is a motivated nonpurity phenomenon. Giving all 14,287 feasible subsets by degree, all 1,809 maximal sets in three sizes, and a 15-orbit symmetry classification including one 36-member optimum orbit is substantive structural/census information. The finite scope is explicit; no inflated universal result is claimed.
